quarterly_data.signal: MOPS filing: the board of subsidiary Delta Electronics (Chongqing) Co., Ltd. approved on August 12, 2026 the construction of the Chongqing phase-2 plant (land leased, construction commissioned); total construction cost provisionally estimated at about RMB 5.46 hundred million (tax included); the construction counterparty and other details will be announced once determined. Stated purpose: to meet future business development needs.
